description.value:
A further-refined medi-gel formula with denser nanite concentration, accelerating tissue regeneration beyond standard field issue.

Whenever you apply Medi-Gel to a creature (including yourself), it restores [[/r 55[healing]]] Hit Points instead of the base 25. This bonus is determined by the character applying the medi-gel, not the recipient. As normal, healing cannot exceed the target's maximum HP, and excess is lost.

This is a tiered upgrade. It replaces Medi-Gel Upgrade I — a character benefits only from their single highest Medi-Gel Upgrade.
